metadata.label: Jellyfish Bell
metadata.description: Glowing translucent jellyfish swarm over deep space; bass onsets make one jelly emit a shockwave.

controlDescriptions.armCount: Number of frilly oral arms near the centre.
controlDescriptions.armLength: Oral arm length relative to the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Multiplies jelly color before the soft tone curve.
controlDescriptions.count: Number of jellyfish floating on screen.
controlDescriptions.dotSpacing: How many dots appear along each tentacle.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeed: How fast glowing dots flow down the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeedVariation: How much dot speed differs between tentacles.
controlDescriptions.hueVariety: How far each jellyfish hue spreads around the color wheel; 0 uses the base hue for all.
controlDescriptions.idleInterval: Fire a shockwave anyway if nothing fired for this many seconds; 0 disables.
controlDescriptions.lengthVariation: How much shorter some tentacles are.
controlDescriptions.pulse: How strongly bass contracts the bell.
controlDescriptions.reactivity: Master scale for all audio reactions.
controlDescriptions.sizeVariation: How much smaller some jellyfish are than the largest.
controlDescriptions.sway: How strongly mids make the tentacles sway.
controlDescriptions.swimFrequency: Average pulse bursts per second for each jellyfish; bursts come at random intervals.
controlDescriptions.tentacleLength: Longest tentacle length relative to bell size.
controlDescriptions.thrust: How far each bell stroke pushes a jellyfish along its heading.
controlDescriptions.tilt: Maximum tilt in radians away from upright.
controlDescriptions.toneSoftness: Coefficient k in col/(1+col*k); higher compresses highlights more.
controlDescriptions.triggerSensitivity: How easily bass, broadband-flux and snare onsets fire shockwaves; higher lowers the onset thresholds.
controlDescriptions.waveDistortion: Directly scales how strongly shockwaves bend the image (refraction amplitude).
controlDescriptions.waveReach: How far a shockwave travels, in aspect-corrected screen units, before it fades out and is recycled.
controlDescriptions.waveSpeed: How fast shockwaves expand, in screen units per second.

metadata.label: Distant Galaxy
metadata.description: Adds one faint, slowly rotating two-arm spiral galaxy far in the background; bass brightens its core slightly.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the galaxy behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint distant galaxy added.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall galaxy strength. It stays very dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.positionX: Horizontal position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.positionY: Vertical position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.rotationSpeed: How fast the spiral turns. Zero holds it still.
controlDescriptions.size: Radius of the galaxy as a fraction of the frame height.

metadata.label: Shooting Stars
metadata.description: Adds rare, thin shooting stars across the upper sky. Strong highs can trigger one.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add shooting stars on top of.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with occasional shooting stars added.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Strength of the head and tail glow.
controlDescriptions.frequency: How often shooting stars appear. Zero turns the random ones off.
controlDescriptions.length: Length of the fading tail behind each star.
controlDescriptions.speed: How fast each star crosses the sky. Higher values give shorter flights.

metadata.label: Starlight Rays
metadata.description: Adds slow diagonal god-rays from above and a soft bloom around the bell; audio level brightens the rays.

image.label: Image
image.description: Scene image to light with rays and bloom.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with starlight rays and bloom.

controlDescriptions.angle: Slant of the shafts in radians.
controlDescriptions.bloom: Strength of the soft glow around bright areas.
controlDescriptions.opacity: Overall opacity of the rays and bloom layer.

metadata.label: Cosmic Nebula
metadata.description: Adds a dim drifting magenta and teal gas nebula near the screen edges; bass brightens it gently.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the nebula behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint nebula added.

controlDescriptions.bassGlow: How strongly bass brightens the nebula.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall nebula strength. It stays dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the gas clouds drift.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint blended into the magenta and teal gas.
controlDescriptions.scale: Size of the cloud features. Higher values give smaller clouds.

metadata.label: Deep Space Finish
metadata.description: Final subtle grade: soft vignette, filmic highlight roll-off, faint film grain, cool shadows with warm highlights, and slight edge chromatic aberration.

controlDescriptions.aberration: Tiny red and blue color fringing toward the edges.
controlDescriptions.exposure: Brightness before tone mapping. Highlights roll off instead of clipping.
controlDescriptions.grade: Strength of the cool shadow and warm highlight tint.
controlDescriptions.grain: Strength of the faint animated film grain.
controlDescriptions.vignette: Darkens the frame edges with a soft elliptical falloff.
